title: What is a File

fakeFiles.story.txt:
Once upon a time.
A robot found a map.
The end.

goal: This lesson covers what a practice file is, and that these files live in a fake folder on this page and not on your real computer.
learn: A file stores text you can use again later
Practice files live in a fake folder on this page
File names end with an extension like .txt
idea: A file holds text that your program can read later, like a note saved under a name such as story.txt. In these lessons the files live in a practice folder on this page. Nothing gets saved to your real desktop, which keeps practice safe and simple.

lines: print("A file has a name, like story.txt")
print("Practice files live on this page")
print("They are not on your real disk")
output: A file has a name, like story.txt
Practice files live on this page
They are not on your real disk

changeOneLine: In the editor above, change the middle message to "Practice files are for learning" and press Run.

practice.text: Print two sentences: what a file stores, and where practice files live.
practice.hint: Use two print() lines. One should say a file stores text, and the other should say practice files live on this page and not on your real computer.
practice.starterTip: Try print("A file stores text you can read later") and print("Practice files live in a fake folder on this page").
practice.gradingNote: Pass if two non-empty prints mention files / practice / page.

practice.text: Print three practice file names from this lesson.
practice.hint: Each name is a string in quotes ending in .txt. story.txt is already there, so fill in two more like note.txt or hello.txt.
practice.starterTip: Add print("note.txt") and print("hello.txt") on the blank lines (or any two other .txt names from the lesson).
practice.gradingNote: Pass if three .txt names are printed.

quiz.question: Where do practice files in this course live?

options.text: In a fake folder on this page

quiz.correct: Right, they live in a fake practice folder on the page and never touch your real disk.
quiz.wrong: These are practice files in a fake folder on the page.

quiz.question: What is a common text file ending?
quiz.correct: Yes, .txt is the usual ending for plain text files.
quiz.wrong: story.txt is a text file name, so look for the .txt ending.

quiz.question: Why use practice files instead of the real disk?

options.text: Safer learning without touching real files

quiz.correct: Right, practice files keep lessons safe and predictable.
quiz.wrong: The fake folder is only for learning.
